subject: Zephyr Therapeutics — IAM evidence intake: SSO assertions, SCIM delta, RBAC mapping
messages:
From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@zephyrtx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@zephyrtx.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IAM artifacts for SIG / SOC2 intake

Hi Priya,

We're starting the SIG intake for Zephyr Therapeutics and the auditors have requested a focused package around access control and identity. Can you help us with the following artifacts?

- A sample of SAML assertion headers (redacted) for a few user sessions in the past 30 days (include timestamp, issuer, NameID format and example attributes).
- SCIM delta export for the last 30 days (additions/updates/deletes) and a short README explaining delta format and userId mapping.
- RBAC role-to-permission mapping and a current Role Ownership spreadsheet (who owns each role).
- Session/token TTLs and any rotation/refresh policies for service-to-service tokens.
- A list of service accounts and their intended scopes.

Deadline: the audit window opens on Sep 10; would appreciate an initial bundle by Sep 3 if possible. If you need an NDA or a secure upload endpoint, let me know — Compliance is cc'd.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Perez
Director, IT Compliance
Zephyr Therapeutics
[Attachment: zephyr_intake_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: IAM artifacts for SIG / SOC2 intake

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble this; below is the proposed intake/checklist and delivery plan. Please confirm scope and whether Zephyr needs raw logs or redacted samples.

Intake checklist (initial bundle we can deliver by Sep 3):
- SAML assertion samples (redacted): 3 user sessions across web and API flows.
- SCIM delta snapshot (30-day): packaged as compressed jsonl with README.
- RBAC mapping: CSV export + short mapping doc.
- Service accounts list: CSV with scope and last-used timestamp.
- Session/token policy summary: human-readable doc + links to policy pages.

Questions:
1) For SCIM, do you need the raw attribute values or are redacted attribute-values acceptable for PII?
2) For role ownership, do you want historical owners or only current owners?

Upload: we have a secure upload workspace — https://secure-upload.redwood.com/zephyrtx/ztx-2026-sig-17. I will pause delivery if you prefer a signed NDA (linked cc: DocuSign).

Attachments included: initial_checklist.csv (contains the checklist above as rows), upload-instructions.txt (upload steps and contacts).

Vanessa will prepare the SCIM packaging notes and a small sample for format verification. Rachel will prepare the RBAC extract and the role-owner spreadsheet.

I'll circle back with a delivery timestamp for each artifact by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Perez <alex.perez@zephyrtx.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM artifacts for SIG / SOC2 intake

On Mon, Aug 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Vanessa will prepare the SCIM packaging notes and a small sample for format verification.

Alex / Priya — quick technical notes from the SCIM/SSO side so Zephyr knows what to expect:

1) SCIM delta packaging
- We will provide a compressed jsonl (newline-delimited JSON) export with one event per line: {event_type, user_id, timestamp, attrs_changed}.
- We will include a mapping table: internal_user_id -> external_id (redwood->zephyr mapping) in CSV.
- For PII attributes (email, displayName), we can provide pseudonymized values unless you require raw values for identity matching.

2) SAML assertion samples
- We will redact NameID value and any PII in attributes, but leave the assertion structure, InResponseTo, issuer, authnInstant, conditions (NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter) intact so auditors can verify flows.
- We'll include one API token exchange flow captured from our auth-proxy (no private key material).

3) RBAC export
- Role definitions will be exported as CSV (role_id, role_name, permissions_list) and a separate role_ownership.xlsx with current owner and contact.

Attachments: scim-delta-sample.json (one-line example), saml-assertion-sample.eml (forwarded SAML response with friendly redactions).

Estimated bundle size: ~12 MB compressed. If Zephyr needs raw logs for correlation, call me — we can arrange a secured syslog transfer but that requires an additional compliance agreement.

-Vanessa
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: scim-delta-sample.json (application/json)] [Attachment: saml-assertion-sample.eml (message/rfc822)]

From: Alex Perez <alex.perez@zephyrtx.com>

Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@zephyrtx.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM artifacts for SIG / SOC2 intake

Thanks, team — that plan works. Sep 3 initial bundle is perfect. A couple of items to confirm before you package: 

- Please include the role-ownership spreadsheet (current owners only is fine) and add one column that maps each Redwood role to our internal least-privilege matrix label (Zephyr-L1, L2, L3).
- For SCIM, pseudonymized attribute values are acceptable for the initial intake; we may request raw values later if there are mapping gaps.
- Please include a 1-page summary explaining how session TTLs are enforced and where refresh tokens are rotated.

We will use your secure upload link; compliance will confirm access and let us know if they need a DocuSign NDA first.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cc'ing Compliance to coordinate the upload.

Best,
Alex
Director, IT Compliance
Zephyr Therapeutics
